Front I/O Panel
Use the case power button to try to start the PC. It requires the Power SW lead, but USB and HD Audio are optional for POST.

COMPATIBILITY CHECK

○ CPU socket matches motherboard
○ RAM type matches motherboard
○ GPU is installed in PCIe x16
○ PSU wattage meets GPU requirement
○ Storage device installed
○ Boot-critical power cables connected
Install compatible components, connect the cables, then test the system.
POST Diagnostics
Press POST Test to see what is missing or incompatible and why. USB and HD Audio are reported as optional warnings rather than POST failures.
